description: Short fictitious texts with folded characters (long s, Kelvin sign, dotless i, fullwidth letters, ligatures, combining marks, zero-width joiners, no-break spaces). Both ports run the rule on the raw text; the expected flags are the Node.js result (patterns compiled with the u flag). Used by rules_identity_request.test.js and test_rules_identity_request.py.
